headline: The mountain got bigger: six courses, crevasses, shortcuts
lede: SSX now rides six original mountains instead of three — every one roughly double the length — and each one gives you a choice of lines instead of just one.

notes.text: Three new originals: BACKCOUNTRY BOWL (long day cruiser with a thundering canyon gap), TIMBER LINE (tight dusk tree slalom), PIPE WORKS (night park of pipes and three-tier rails).

Route choices on every course: fly a crevasse off the lip or skirt it on the shoulder; drop into an express chute that trades tricks for 1.45x speed; or climb to the powder-band rail that pays double trickle.
RACE is still three heats — but which three of the six you ride rotates on the seed, and online rooms rotate together off the host seed. Seed 0 keeps the classic opening.
ssxcheck grew to 285 gates: gaps physics (fast flies, crawl is swallowed), chutes, high rails, the rotation, and both tournaments re-proven winnable at slack economy.
